verdict.rationale: The only recurring-schedule evidence is RSS campaigns that send 'according to its schedule' (mailchimp-docs-5); all other campaigns send immediately, and there is no documentation of an API or workflow engine (e.g., Customer Journeys automation) for AI-native users to configure arbitrary recurring jobs. Missing for 10: explicit automation/workflow API docs, recurring-trigger configuration beyond RSS, and any independent confirmation of automation reliability.
